newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore Q3 labour productivity off 2.8 pct on yr.
newsitem.headline: Singapore Q3 labour productivity off 2.8 pct on yr.

text.p: Singapore's labour productivity fell 2.8 percent year-on-year in the third quarter, after growing one percent in the second quarter, the Ministry of Trade and Industry said on Friday.
The ministry had previously said labour productivity grew 4.2 percent in the first quarter 1996.
It said on Friday that excluding construction, the third quarter decline in productivity was 1.1 percent, which reflected the moderation in economic activity.
Aside from transport and communications, the other key sectors recorded declines, the ministry said.
Employment remained healthy in the third quarter with 17,300 jobs created, but that was lower than the 20,400 jobs created in the same period last year, it said.

But the labour market remained tight with the unemplyment rate in September at 1.4 percent, compared with 3.0 percent in June. The unemployment rate in September last year was also 1.4 percent. -- Singapore Newsroom (65-870 3084)
